fluff.overview: The Black Wolf is a heavy class battle armor developed jointly by the scientist castes of Clan Wolf and Clan Wolf-in-Exile. Entering production in 3138, the suit was designed for close-in assault and support roles, configurable across multiple weapon loadouts to match mission requirements. Built on a Clan technology base, the design prioritizes heavy armor protection and durability over speed, giving it the staying power expected of a front-line Clan combat platform. Despite the complications that arose from its dual-origin development, the Black Wolf earned a reputation as a flexible and capable suit in the hands of both Clans.
fluff.capabilities:
The Black Wolf masses 1,500 kilograms and prioritizes protection over mobility. Its top ground speed of ten kilometers per hour is offset by jump jets capable of thirty-meter leaps, giving troopers the ability to clear obstacles and close on targets. The right arm mounts a Heavy Battle Claw for OmniMech transport and close-quarters combat. Reactive armor plating, totaling 385 kilograms, offers strong defense against explosive weapons and missile volleys, though it is less effective against concentrated energy fire.

The Heavy Flamer configuration equips a heavy flamer on the left arm modular weapon point. This weapon excels at clearing fortified positions and flushing infantry from concealment, generating intense thermal output that can overwhelm lighter targets and ignite surrounding structures. Limited fuel reserves demand careful shot discipline, but in urban warfare and building clearance operations, the heavy flamer delivers considerable psychological and physical impact.
fluff.deployment: During the defense of Knockbridge on Incukalns, Clan Wolf-in-Exile Points armed with heavy flamers sprang a devastating ambush as Jade Falcon forces advanced into the suburbs. The five-trooper formations exploited tight urban corridors to maximize the weapon area effect, turning entire blocks into firetraps that stalled the Falcon assault and bought time for Beta Galaxy withdrawal.
fluff.history:
The Black Wolf grew from a rare collaboration between the scientist castes of Clan Wolf and Clan Wolf-in-Exile. Beginning around 3134, researchers from both factions pooled resources to create a heavy battle armor that might serve as a bridge toward reunification. Production lines opened at WC Site 2 on Arc-Royal, W-7 Facilities on Weingarten, and later at Corean Enterprises MacAdams-Suharno on Stewart. The suit debuted in 3138, but the political hopes it carried were short-lived. When Khan Seth Ward allied with the Lyran Commonwealth and carved the Wolf Empire from its territory, the Black Wolf became a source of bitter division rather than unity.

The suit gained widespread attention during the invasion of Tharkad in 3143, where embedded Lyran media captured images of Black Wolf troopers storming fortified positions in the Triad district. For Clan Wolf-in-Exile and their Lyran allies, the armor they had helped create became an object of dread. Despite this fraught history, both halves of Clan Wolf continued fielding the Black Wolf in significant numbers. Clan Wolf-in-Exile assigned the suit to its touman out of necessity, while Clan Wolf Elementals embraced it eagerly. Divergences in production protocols between the Arc-Royal and Weingarten facilities rendered parts from the two lines incompatible, a practical complication that mirrored the political rift between the Clans.
